instruction: Candid action photograph, medium full shot. In an indoor boxing gym with black wall mats, the woman in the blue zip-up jacket (R2) stands in the foreground right, throwing a punch with her pink boxing gloves at a red hanging punching bag. Behind her, the man in the gray t-shirt (R1) stands in a boxing guard, watching her closely. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead gym lighting.
